svg.text: Does CEBPA loss differ across AT2 starting states?
Broad identity attenuation is a published premise; the baseline-state interaction is the question
Cebpa loss versus matched control within each state
Baseline states defined independently of the response
Dashed: proposed comparison / readout • icons and counts are qualitative
Post-treatment labels and differential survival can mimic selectivity; pooled wells are not animal replication.
